claims.text: generation_files returns fresh complete bytes for every selected historical prefix with gen/<n> entry, journal, units and manifest files plus CURRENT and root mirrors.
verify_projection compares the on-disk projection against exact ledger-derived bytes and returns issues without repairing artifacts.
rebuild stages new generations under the publish lock, fsyncs them, publishes CURRENT and mirrors, and raises stale_rev when a newer committed prefix exists.

decision.rule: Change here when memory generation layout, projection verification or rebuild publication needs to change.
decision.failure: Projection verification reports differences, rebuild refuses stale snapshots, or staged generations fail verification.

questions.q: Where does generation_files build complete generation bytes from the ledger prefix?
Where should I change how verify_projection detects projection differences without repairing?
Where can I debug why rebuild raises stale_rev or fails staged verification?
